facts.fact: 实验室_refreshed：她加入时研究已过半，被「扔进深水区自己扑腾」——正合她意。
facts.anchor: I joined at about the halfway point of the study

facts.fact: 博物馆日前的锚点：这间实验室就是她 post-grad 的既定去向，PhD 大概率也在这里。
facts.anchor: This is the lab where I have my post-grad program lined up.

facts.fact: Oliver 的约会短信：博物馆门口一点见——「Maybe. You'll have to come to find out.」
facts.anchor: Meet me outside the museum at 1

facts.fact: 双咖啡杯已成两人的例行仪式（chai 对 coffee）。
Phar Lap 科普名场面：澳洲最伟大的赛马、疑遭谋杀——标本（皮肤）就陈列在馆里。
facts.anchor: Phar Lap. Australia’s greatest racehorse. Presumably murdered.

facts.fact: Forest Gallery 是 Mum 生前带他来的「我们的地方」——空气一沉，他照常往前走。
facts.anchor: Mum always took me here. It was our thing.

facts.fact: Eden 的 Black Saturday 山火记忆：全家守着收音机等疏散令，烟味浸进衣服，晚霞烧橙了几个月。
facts.anchor: watching my parent’s anxious faces as they spent the whole day by the radio

facts.fact: fairy wren 求偶课：雄鸟才有艳色——Oliver 的鸟类冷知识时间。
facts.anchor: Males have that vibrant colour, not the female.

facts.fact: Forest Gallery 第四吻的引线：她夸他「谈热爱事物时最好看」——「Tell me again」。
facts.anchor: Have I ever told you how good you look when you’re talking about something you’re passionate about?

facts.fact: 寿司店复盘：她怕自己被改变——旧的不那么在意了，但又想带着他继续。
facts.anchor: It’s like he’s…changed who I am.

facts.fact: 复盘的落点：我爱我的事业，但现在想让他站在旁边一起做。
facts.anchor: But now I want to do it with him by my side.
